items.uz: Axir men senga necha marta aytdim!
items.en: After all, I told you so many times!

items.uz: Bilaman-ku, lekin vaziyat o'zgardi.
items.en: I know, but the situation changed.

items.uz: Agar meni tinglaganingda, bu bo'lmagan bo'lardi.
items.en: If you had listened to me, this wouldn't have happened.

items.uz: Endi nima qilishni taklif qilasan?
items.en: What do you suggest we do now?

items.uz: Birinchi navbatda xatoni tan olishimiz kerak.
items.en: First of all, we need to acknowledge the mistake.

items.uz: Bu haqiqatan ham to'g'ri fikr.
items.en: This is indeed a correct thought.

items.uz: Keling, buni birga hal qilaylik.
items.en: Let's resolve this together.

items.uz: Axir biz bir jamoamiz-ku.
items.en: After all, we are one team, you know.

items.uz: Rozi bo'lganingiz uchun rahmat.
items.en: Thank you for agreeing.

items.uz: Bundan buyon ehtiyotkorroq bo'lamiz.
items.en: From now on, we'll be more careful.

items.uz: Bu tajribadan saboq olishimiz kerak.
items.en: We need to learn a lesson from this experience.

items.uz: Kelgusida bunday bo'lmay qolmaydi, deb umid qilaman.
items.en: I hope this won't happen again in the future.

items.uz: Agar o'sha paytda boshqacha yo'l tanlaganimda edi...
items.en: If I had chosen a different path at that time...

items.uz: O'tmishni o'zgartira olmaymiz, faqat kelajakka qaraylik.
items.en: We can't change the past, let's just look to the future.

items.uz: Ba'zan orqaga qarab, xato qilganimni tushunaman.
items.en: Sometimes looking back, I understand I made mistakes.

items.uz: Har bir tajriba bizni kimlargadir aylantiradi.
items.en: Every experience turns us into someone.

items.uz: Agar u paytda bilganimda, boshqacha harakat qilgan bo'lardim.
items.en: If I had known back then, I would have acted differently.

items.uz: O'sha yillar hayotimning eng qiyin davri edi.
items.en: Those years were the most difficult period of my life.

items.uz: Ammo o'sha qiyinchiliklar meni mustahkamladi.
items.en: But those hardships strengthened me.

items.uz: Har bir inson o'z sinovlaridan saboq oladi.
items.en: Every person learns lessons from their trials.

items.uz: Men o'tmishimdan afsuslanmayman.
items.en: I don't regret my past.

items.uz: Chunki har bir qadam meni bugungi kunga olib keldi.
items.en: Because every step brought me to today.

items.uz: Kelajak haqida qanday fikrdasiz?
items.en: What do you think about the future?

items.uz: Umidvorman, chunki tajribamiz bizga kuch beradi.
items.en: I'm hopeful, because our experience gives us strength.
